_source: docs/0.4.0/00-framework.md — S8 MVP_Test Plan_DA.xlsx (re-issued 30 Jul 2026), transcribed verbatim (FWK-01..FWK-05, FWK-17, FWK-18, D-17). The framework is what we test; the KB (C-37) is domain truth we test against — this file ships with the product.
l1_themes: Third party data quality and controls

l2_areas.name: Portfolio Representativeness & Selection Bias
l2_areas.objective: Ensure datasets appropriately represent intended analytical populations across segments, vintages, channels and geographies.
l2_areas.why_it_matters: Non-representative datasets create biased calibration, weak generalization and unstable analytical outcomes.

l2_areas.name: Historical Depth, Observation Windows & Censoring
l2_areas.objective: Ensure sufficient historical depth, seasoning and observable outcomes for intended analytical usage.
l2_areas.why_it_matters: Insufficient history or incomplete observation windows weaken long-horizon analytics and forecasting.

l2_areas.name: Downturn & Regime Coverage
l2_areas.objective: Ensure stressed and structurally different economic regimes are represented.
l2_areas.why_it_matters: Datasets concentrated in benign periods fail under stress conditions.

l2_areas.name: Target Definition & Label Consistency
l2_areas.objective: Ensure analytical targets and outcomes are consistently defined across systems and time.
l2_areas.why_it_matters: Inconsistent targets create artificial shifts and unstable analytical behavior.

l2_areas.name: Missingness Mechanism & Data Availability
l2_areas.objective: Assess the analytical implications of missing data beyond completeness.
l2_areas.why_it_matters: Non-random missingness materially impacts segmentation and calibration.

l2_areas.name: Outliers, Extreme Values & Plausibility
l2_areas.objective: Assess whether extremes represent genuine behavior or data defects.
l2_areas.why_it_matters: Incorrect handling of extremes distorts analytical relationships.

l2_areas.name: Temporal Integrity & Feature Leakage
l2_areas.objective: Ensure predictors are temporally aligned and free from future-information leakage.
l2_areas.why_it_matters: Leakage artificially inflates analytical and model performance.

l2_areas.name: Feature Stability & Behavioral Consistency
l2_areas.objective: Assess whether predictor behavior remains stable across time and regimes.
l2_areas.why_it_matters: Unstable features reduce analytical reliability and model robustness.

l2_areas.name: Dataset Drift & Degradation Monitoring
l2_areas.objective: Monitor whether datasets remain representative and fit-for-purpose over time.
l2_areas.why_it_matters: Analytical datasets degrade due to portfolio, operational and macro changes.

l2_areas.name: Pipeline Stability & Schema Consistency
l2_areas.objective: Assess whether ingestion and transformation processes remain stable.
l2_areas.why_it_matters: Operational changes silently degrade analytical datasets.

l2_areas.l1_theme: Third party data quality and controls
l2_areas.name: External / vendor data robustness & change control
l2_areas.objective: Verifies if external/ vendor data samples are sourced from approved parties with necessary controls and governance
l2_areas.why_it_matters: Lack of robust data quality and control testing in leveraged third party data leads to spurious outcomes and serious operational errors

test_areas.name: KB-driven data validation (rules, distributional & relationship)
test_areas.plan_a_dimensions: Pipeline & Schema Stability; Outliers & Plausibility; Monotonicity & Directional Consistency

test_areas.name: Outcome window / censoring completeness (incl. seasoning/maturity)
test_areas.plan_a_dimensions: Outcome Window Consistency; Historical Depth & Censoring

test_areas.name: KB relationship set (SME generated + AI proposed, SME validated)

register.name: Single-feature target separation
register.what_it_computes: How strongly does each feature separate the target alone?
register.metric: univariate AUC; Information Value (alt: mutual information)
register.threshold_rule_default: AUC > 0.90 OR IV > 0.5 → 'too good to be true' flag / AUC < 0.60 OR IV < 0.05 → 'poor discrimination' flag
register.enabled_by: Phase 1B Slice 4 acceptance gate: governed manifest, partial outcomes, reusable artifacts, candidate review and controlled issue hand-off

register.name: Cross-field business rule
register.what_it_computes: Does each row satisfy a hard cross-field rule (with exceptions)?

register.name: Row-completeness reconciliation
register.what_it_computes: Are facility-period rows present between each facility's first and last observed reporting periods?
register.metric: continuity coverage = received required facility-period pairs / required pairs within observed spans
register.threshold_rule_default: continuity coverage below 95% flags a gap; segment analysis is optional

register.name: Value-semantics classification
register.what_it_computes: Classify each field/null as valid / missing / censored / stale / N-A
register.threshold_rule_default: tag per KB rule (no cutoff) — OUTPUT other tests consume

register.name: Directional / monotonic consistency (segmented)
register.what_it_computes: Do two variables relate in the expected direction, by segment?
register.metric: Broad quantile-bin average target shape; Spearman rank correlation; standardized univariate regression (Pearson displayed only)
register.threshold_rule_default: 3/3 directional agreement = strong; 2/3 = moderate; otherwise conflicting, weak/flat, non-monotonic, or insufficient data (optional segmentation; no adjacent-bin inversion count)
register.enabled_by: T2-D11 governed directional-consistency production contract (1 Sep 2026)

register.name: Label-consistency rule
register.what_it_computes: Are label fields internally consistent by process?

register.name: Population Stability Index (PSI)
register.metric: PSI per feature & segment (alt: JS divergence, Wasserstein)
register.enabled_by: D-22 / DX-06 (19 Aug 2026): PSI acceptance gate

register.name: Resolution / maturity rate by vintage
register.what_it_computes: Share of outcomes resolved vs open, per vintage
register.threshold_rule_default: resolution rate < X% for a vintage → flag censoring

register.name: AI-proposal workflow
register.what_it_computes: AI profiles the data and proposes KB-absent candidate relationships; SME validates; accepted ones run as new test-2-mode checks (a workflow, not a computation — no test-6 executor)
register.metric: confidence score (ranking only) — no data metric
register.threshold_rule_default: confidence above surface-cutoff → present to SME; the SME decision is the gate
register._l2_note: any dimension — reads/writes the KB across areas; not counted in area coverage

scoring_weights.basis: equal weight per registered diagnostic within its test area; areas weighted equally — recorded for FWK-16, consumed when the score panel lands (P6)
scoring_weights.coverage_statement: FWK-16 coverage honesty: a score must state what it covers. Four of 9 registered diagnostics are executable (#2 feature-target separation, #6 row completeness, #11 directional consistency, and #14 population stability); #4 cross-field business rule is workflow-pending while it undergoes additional testing and refinement. The score panel names executable, run, not-run, and workflow-pending diagnostics and does not present this partial coverage as a weighted health score.
scoring_weights.superseded_scheme_note: The retired scheme weighted 14 tests by area criticality (fw_family_weights, WEIGHTS Critical=5/High=3/Medium=1). Fixture delta: the old roll-up scored a 3-result fixture (2 units, passed_fraction 0.5 and 1.0) as ~75 'health' while silently covering only the retired registry; the new scheme refuses a headline number under partial 4/9 executable coverage and reports the split instead.
